onboarding.title: Heading of the getting started checklist.
onboarding.next: Label before the title of the next step, for example "Next: Save it to your collection".
onboarding.completeTitle: Heading when every step is done.
onboarding.steps.send.hint: An echo service sends back what it receives.
onboarding.steps.variable.hint: {{example}} is the literal variable syntax and stays unchanged. baseUrl is a variable name.
onboarding.steps.variable.defined: Legend entry for a variable that has a value (shown in a normal colour).
onboarding.steps.variable.missing: Legend entry for a variable without a value (shown in a warning colour).
onboarding.steps.check.hint: res.status is script code and stays as it is. Add checks is a button name in the Checks tab.
onboarding.done: Button that finishes the guided tour. Verb.
